mentions.name: Forth compiler for the NES
mentions.description: A Forth compiler targeting the NES, planned to be open-sourced once the code quality improves.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been on/off working on a Forth compiler for the NES.  It will be open source soon enough but I'm not happy with the code right now as it's extremely messy, repetitive, and buggy, but I think it's turning out ok.
